facts.value: Double room in a house: €932/month Dublin average; city centre €965 (no ensuite), single room in a house €823 (Q3 2026)
facts.notes: Average listed (asking) rents, not signed contracts. UCD Global estimates accommodation at €830-€2,250/month, median €1,200 (April 2026).

facts.value: Studio: €1,579/month in Dublin City Centre, €1,605 in South Dublin City (Q3 2026)
facts.notes: 1-bed apartment: €2,027 city centre, €2,115 South Dublin City (same report).

facts.value: €1,735 (low) / €2,445 (median) / €4,035 (high) per month incl. accommodation (UCD estimate, April 2026)
facts.notes: Plus one-off costs, e.g. €300 IRP and up to €690/year health insurance for non-EU students.

facts.value: Student/Young Adult Leap: weekly cap €12.00 (daily €3.00) on Dublin Bus, Luas, DART, Commuter Rail Zone 1; UCD budgets €60-€120/month
Mild and damp: mean daily max 8.0°C in Jan, 19.5°C in Jul; 772.5 mm rain/year, ~137 days with ≥1 mm (Dublin Airport 1991-2020)
Large student scene: TCD has 168 clubs and societies in the city centre; UCD has 80+ societies and 60+ sports clubs
English: teaching is in English and TCD requires official proof of English proficiency from all applicants
facts.source_name: Trinity College Dublin - Undergraduate admission requirements

facts.value: Part-time jobs on and off campus; UCD lists on-campus roles (Ambassador, Global Guide, Students' Union, Campus Assistant) and advises being realistic about work hours
facts.notes: Non-EU students on Stamp 2: max 20 h/week in term, 40 h/week in holidays (see Ireland bureaucracy). No official statistic on student job availability found.

facts.value: No data on typical student pay found; legal floor €14.15/h (age 20+), €12.74 (19), €11.32 (18), €9.91 (under 18) in 2026
facts.notes: Value is the statutory minimum, not an observed average student wage. Budget 2027: €14.94/h from 1 Jan 2027 (requires legislation).
